title: Québec Mega Trail — results
claims: The official results page lists the QMT135 course records as Kamil Lesniak (POL) 16:40:30 (2026) and Valérie Arsenault (CAN) 18:12:06 (2026).
The page's top results link goes to my.raceresult.com/407575/ without a year label, followed by links labelled 2025, 2024, 2023, 2022, 2021, 2019, 2018, 2017, 2016, 2015, 2014, 2013 and 2012.
The page still lists course records for the retired QMT100 Miles (160 km) and QMT110 distances.
